description: This file defines API endpoint specifications for managing Wi-Fi BSSs within a hardware interface module. It includes operations for adding, listing, deleting, retrieving, setting, and resetting statistics of Wi-Fi BSS entities, with detailed request/response schemas and error handling info. It appears to be part of a REST API specification in JSON format, likely for a firmware or device management system.
